pixel_convention: Original distorted JPEG pixels; x right, y down, origin upper-left; 960x540. Never use these as already-undistorted pixels.
world_convention: Original COLMAP model 2 arbitrary SfM world; camera rotation is world-to-camera, p_cam=R@(X-centre). NO ENU/Unity/source registration applied.
lens_correction: SIMPLE_RADIAL [f,cx,cy,k], x_dist=x*(1+k*r^2). cv2.undistortPoints with [k,0,0,0,0] used only for calculation; original endpoints retained.
line_selection_method: Manually identify physical upright corners/jambs in original and nearby registered images, then freeze OpenCV LSD_REFINE_STD endpoints. Detector proposals on printed graphics, ceiling seams, diagonal braces, escalator rails, freestanding poster and people are rejected semantically before fitting.
caveats: Architectural upright and visually level-floor hypotheses are not a surveyed gravity/floor-grade measurement.
Endpoint subpixel digits preserve detector output, not subpixel ground-truth accuracy; selection sigma is a sensitivity assumption.
Held-out frames share the same SfM bundle and sometimes physical features: not independent surveyed control.
Camera calibration, rolling shutter, reconstruction drift and actual construction tolerances are not included in endpoint Monte Carlo.
Exterior and interior floor patches are fitted separately. No equal elevations, constant camera height, metric scale, or source-floor coordinates are assumed.
Quality-filtered floor tracks can retain mismatches/reflections; individual plane outliers remain explicitly recorded, not silently removed.
All floor planes are diagnostics only and do not influence the plumb-line vertical fit.

vertical_estimate.method: Interpretation plane n_world=R.T@normalize(ray_a cross ray_b); frame-balanced length-capped weighted SVD; 12 Huber IRLS iterations. Up sign chosen toward camera image-up (negative SfM Y here).

endpoint_only_monte_carlo.interpretation: Selection-sensitivity conditional on fixed camera rotations/intrinsics, not total confidence interval or surveyed accuracy.
